candidates.change_summary: Replace `proposalCount += 1;` with `proposalCount += 2;` so that the counter increments by 2 instead of 1 after newGrantProposal.
Delete `proposalCount += 1;` so proposalCount never increments, always remaining at the previous value.
Replace `VADER = _vader;` with `VADER = _usdv;` so that VADER is set to the wrong address.
Delete the assignment `VADER = _vader;` so VADER retains its default zero address.
Replace 'USDV = _usdv;' with 'USDV = address(0);' so USDV is zero address instead of the provided argument.
Replace 'USDV = _usdv;' with 'USDV = _vader;' so USDV is set to the VADER address instead of the intended USDV address.
Replace 'USDV = _usdv;' with 'USDV = _vault;' so USDV is set to the VAULT address instead of the intended USDV address.
Delete the statement 'USDV = _usdv;' so USDV retains its default value of address(0).
